provenance.edition: Breitkopf & Härtel, 1888, as identified by Mutopia-2015/08/18-931
provenance.rights: The underlying composition and Mutopia typesetting are Public Domain; original MIDI and LilyPond source are retained unchanged.
provenance.tempoChoice: Quarter note = 72 follows the LilyPond source; its MIDI encodes 833333 microseconds per quarter, rounded to an integer microsecond.
provenance.performanceChoice: Unfold both printed volta repeats with their first and second endings. Retain MIDI grace-note timing and restore the final eighth rest from LilyPond.
